title: What's New: Matching Purchase Invoices to Order and Receipt Lines (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Scenario 1: matching invoice to multiple order lines
Matching with receipt lines and posting invoice
Advanced scenario: item tracking and directed put-away pick

features.name: Match invoice line to multiple order lines
features.description: Ability to match a single invoice line to one or multiple non-received order lines, supporting scenarios where one invoice covers multiple order lines.

features.name: Match invoice to partial receipt lines
features.description: Capability to match invoice lines to many partial receipt lines, with ability to invoice receipts partially.

features.name: Auto-post order receipt when posting invoice
features.description: Automatic posting of order receipts when posting a matched invoice, available through a received on invoice flag on purchase orders.
caveats: Applies to simple purchase orders without complex receipt handling

features.name: Get order lines action
features.description: New action to retrieve and display all available order lines for matching to invoice lines, automatically creating one invoice line per order line.

features.name: Matched order line user interface
features.description: New UI for managing order line matching on purchase invoices, allowing selection and matching of multiple order lines and viewing of receipts in tree structure.

features.name: Received on invoice flag
features.description: Flag that can be set on purchase orders to mark them as received on invoice, enabling automatic receipt posting when the invoice is posted.

features.name: Item tracking support in invoice matching
features.description: Support for matching invoices to orders with item tracking, including serial item tracking with visibility to serial numbers and receipt shipment numbers.
caveats: Workflow differs with directed put-away and pick locations; matching must occur before setting quantities

features.name: Directed put-away and pick integration
features.description: Invoice matching functionality works with locations using directed put-away and pick, requiring match to be set before quantity can be entered.
caveats: Different workflow compared to non-directed put-away locations

features.name: Item tracking entries action
features.description: Action showing which serial numbers are being invoiced from receipt, with receipt shipment number field indicating which receipt the serial numbers belong to.
